post.summary: Book a new parcel using an accepted pricing quote

201.description: Booked parcel aggregate wrapped in standard data envelope

413.description: Request body exceeds 64 KB size limit

422.description: Semantic validation failure, expired quote, or quote zone/weight mismatch
